title: Ask AI
subtitle: About {{table}}
intro: Ask a question about the records of {{table}}: the answer is a number, a chart or a table, computed from the records you can see.

privacy.namesOnly: The AI reads the names of the fields you can see, never their values. Cellhive computes the numbers.
privacy.withData: The AI reads the names of the fields you can see, and the totals of an answer to write a short summary. Cellhive computes the numbers.

narrative: AI summary of the numbers above

unanswerable.title: Couldn't answer this yet
unanswerable.detail: Try asking another way: say what to count or add up, and how to group it.

waiting.later: Computing the numbers, and fixing how the question was read if needed…
waiting.laterWithData: Computing the numbers, then writing a short summary…
waiting.hint: AI can take up to 90 seconds to answer.

composer.label: Your question
composer.keys: Enter asks · Shift+Enter for a new line

errors.AI_QUOTA_EXCEEDED: Your organization has used up today's AI quota.
errors.AI_TIMEOUT: The AI took longer than 90 seconds. Try again, or ask a simpler question.
errors.AI_NOT_CONFIGURED: AI is turned off or not set up for this organization. An organization admin can set it up in Organization settings › AI.
errors.AI_INVALID_OUTPUT: The AI could not turn this question into numbers in 3 tries. Rephrase it, or name the fields to use.
errors.QUERY_TIMEOUT: The numbers took too long to compute. Try again, or narrow the question with a filter.
errors.WIDGET_TOO_LARGE: The answer has too many groups ({{groups, number}}; at most {{limit, number}}). Ask for a coarser grouping, or add a filter.
